mapper.select: INSERT INTO rpt_snapshot_job(tenant_id,kind,fingerprint) VALUES (#{tenantId},#{kind.code},#{fingerprint}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,kind) WHERE state='BUILDING' DO NOTHING RETURNING id
SELECT FROM rpt_snapshot_job WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND kind=#{kind.code} AND state='BUILDING'
SELECT FROM rpt_snapshot_job WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE rpt_snapshot_job SET cursor_id=#{cursor} WHERE tenant_id=#{j.tenantId} AND id=#{j.id} AND cursor_id=#{j.cursorId} AND state='BUILDING'
UPDATE rpt_snapshot_job SET state=#{state},finished_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE tenant_id=#{j.tenantId} AND id=#{j.id} AND state='BUILDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rpt_snapshot_current(tenant_id,kind,job_id) VALUES (#{j.tenantId},#{j.kind},#{j.id}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,kind) DO UPDATE SET job_id=excluded.job_id
mapper.select: SELECT source_id,company_id,partner_id,warehouse_id,sku_id,batch_no,business_date,quantity,reserved,locked,in_transit,amount,reduction,settled,paid FROM rpt_snapshot_fact WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND job_id=#{jobId} AND source_id>#{afterId} ORDER BY source_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT coalesce(sum(quantity),0) AS quantity,coalesce(sum(in_transit),0) AS in_transit,sum(amount) AS amount, coalesce(sum(reduction),0) AS reduction,coalesce(sum(greatest(0,amount-reduction-settled)),0) AS unsettled, count(*) FILTER (WHERE amount IS NULL) AS unknown_amounts,count(*) AS rows FROM rpt_snapshot_fact WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND job_id=#{jobId}

SELECT CASE WHEN #{asOf}::date-business_date <= 30 THEN '0-30' WHEN #{asOf}::date-business_date <= 60 THEN '31-60' WHEN #{asOf}::date-business_date <= 90 THEN '61-90' ELSE '90+' END AS bucket, sum(greatest(0,amount-reduction-settled)) AS outstanding,count(*) AS rows FROM rpt_snapshot_fact WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND job_id=#{jobId} AND amount-reduction-settled>0 GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM rpt_snapshot_fact WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND job_id=#{jobId} AND source_id IN (SELECT source_id FROM rpt_snapshot_fact WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND job_id=#{jobId} ORDER BY source_id LIMIT #{limit})

DELETE FROM rpt_snapshot_job WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{jobId} AND state != 'BUILDING' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rpt_snapshot_current WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND job_id=#{jobId}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rpt_snapshot_fact WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND job_id=#{jobId})
